strings.SLO_tiso_dead_desc: With Jozef Tiso's death the country has been thrown into chaos. The goverment is compleatly paralyzed and the people, starting to realise this, are demanding change. We must act fast to stop any further instability.
strings.SLO_Chained_Minds_desc: To nobody's wonder, free expression of opinion isn't allowed in Slovakia. While some may argue that free speech is undermining goverment stability, and thus its disallowance is fundamental to a functioning state, people aren't very happy about it, as aren't the thinkers.
strings.SLO_Political_Tensions_desc: While Tiso has been our undisputed leader for over 20 years, his health has been declining, as it always does. This, of course, means that everyone involved in Slovakian politics have started vying for power, in all forms possible. And if it wasn't enough, reports about zero resistance activity are appearing to be false...
strings.SLO_Agitated_Workers_desc: While the Republic has been doing quite fine the past few decades, problems still haunt her, such as the workers. Be it low wages, poor working conditions, or just a general disagreement with the goverment, the workers are on constant strikes.
strings.SLO_Uncompetitive_Economy_desc: Fascism, as it would appear, has not been the kindest to our economy. This should be resolved, if we are to not suffer a complete economic breakdown.
strings.SLO_skeleton.1.desc: Tiso is dead, Štefan takes over.
strings.SLO_skeleton.2.desc: The Slovak National Uprising actually succeeds, Jan Golian takes over.
